trigger: Qwen3 source-validation log source-45679618_0.out reported that explicit generation settings were replaced by model defaults
cause: When a supplied GenerationConfig value equals the global default, Transformers can replace it with the checkpoint default. Qwen3 do_sample=False, temperature=1.0 and top_p=1.0 became True, 0.6 and 0.95.
fix: Pass use_model_defaults=False to generate alongside the explicitly configured copy of the checkpoint generation config. Native token IDs are retained.

validation.gpu: The prior source numerical gates passed on H100 for both models. The source gates will be rerun under the corrected implementation; CPU tests do not substitute for these gates.
